research.project: Intelligent Bengali Sign Language Recognition & Braille Representation
bullets: Developed a multimodal deep learning framework combining EfficientNet-B0, ViT, and GCNs for sign recognition.
Implemented a Cross-Modal Attention Fusion mechanism, achieving 91.27% accuracy and 0.9125 Macro F1-score.
Generated Bangladeshi Braille Unicode from recognized signs to support accessible communication.

projects.name: AgriNetwork
projects.description: A full-stack peer-to-peer agricultural marketplace facilitating direct transactions between farmers and consumers, featuring real-time bidding and live video streaming.
bullets: Developed a peer-to-peer agricultural marketplace for direct farmer-consumer sales.
Implemented real-time interactive product live streaming paired with a dynamic live-bidding system using Socket.io and WebRTC.
Integrated automated KYC (Know Your Customer) verification workflows to secure transactional pipelines.

projects.name: 3D Fishing Game
projects.description: An interactive 3D simulation game utilizing Python and PyOpenGL for real-time graphics rendering, complete with custom event handling and physics.
bullets: Developed a full 3D simulation game utilizing PyOpenGL for real-time computer graphics rendering.
Implemented custom 3D coordinate transformations, view projections, and bounding-box collision detection algorithms.
Designed responsive keyboard and mouse event-handling mechanics to handle user controls, hook physics, and state-driven environment interactions.
